title: random
text:
random

maria: Huge shoutout to @devon — tracked down the mystery bulk snack box and resuscitated the tea station this morning. pantry = operational again :tada:
alex: Legend. The label-maker tape was the key? :eyes:
devon: Haha yes, turns out someone (not naming names) mixed sweet and savory aisles. Fixed small stock map, labeled the shelves, and left a sticky map on the fridge.
lia: Omg thank you. My 3pm meeting survival rate just doubled. Sending cookies to the chaos manager? :cookie: :heart_eyes:
ops-bot: DELIVERY: 1 x assorted cookies (order #ORD-98421) scheduled for pickup at 15:05. ETA ~20 minutes.
sam: Can we put a short doc in the handbook for pantry stewardship + ordering cadence? I can draft a tiny checklist (who orders, preferred vendors, allergen note).
maria: Yes please, @sam — that'd be awesome. Also devon — we'd like to nominate you for this week's "Office Lifesaver" shoutout. Accept? :medal_sports:
devon: I accept in exchange for the remaining bag of salted caramel pretzels :grin: 
lia: Deal. I'm adding a tiny poll: "Preferred communal snack: sweet vs savory" reactions only. Cast votes with :chocolate_bar: or :pretzel:.
alex: :pretzel: (sneaky savory takeover)
sam: :chocolate_bar: (for the greater good)
maria: Thanks again team — small things like this make a big difference. Also leaving a post-it with the new pantry map and an emoji legend. :)
